articleTitle: A Study of Audio-to-Text Conversion Software Using Whispers Model
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: This paper explores the potential of utilizing the Whispers model to create unified interfaces for audio-to-text in the context of Natural Language Processing (NLP). It offers possibilities for accurately converting spoken language into written texts. Whispers model by OpenAI is a state-of-the-art model in the field of NLP and is employe. In this study, various metrics and criteria are considered to evaluate the performance of the developed audio-to-text conversion software, including loading time, stress test, and transcription accuracy and speed. The proposal is capable of handling up to 180 concurrent users with an average response time of 309 ms and 471.5 requests per second. The results and findings of this study provide valuable insights into the effectiveness and limitations of the Whispers model in the context of audio-to-text conversion.

articleTitle: Hybrid Cryptography and Steganography with Rivest Shamir Adleman and End of File Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Information security is very important, especially in technology and information exchange. This information will likely be spread to irresponsible parties in the file transfer process using the internet. Therefore, it is necessary to maintain the security of the information. Cryptographic techniques with the Rivest-Shamir-Adleman (RSA) algorithm can be used. However, the RSA algorithm still has weaknesses. That is, intruders can suspect it due to the scrambling of information. In this research, information security is carried out with cryptography and steganography to overcome these weaknesses. Steganography hides information by inserting files containing information into images with the End Of File (EOF) algorithm. In implementing the two algorithms, five processes are carried out: key generation, encryption, insertion extraction, and decryption. The computational time for applying the RSA algorithm to encrypt test files with an average difference in the number of characters takes 825 ms. Meanwhile, the decryption process takes an average of 781.2 ms with an average throughput of 221,470 Kbps. While the EOF algorithm on images with a resolution of 400x400 to 1200x1200 has an average Mean Square Error (MSE) value of 31,852 and an average Peak Signal Noise Ratio (PSNR) value of 45,929 dB, applying these two algorithms has a good security system.

articleTitle: Covid-19 Early Diagnosis Based on Transfer Learning and Modified CNN Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Covid-19 has spread worldwide and has been stated as a pandemic by the WHO in 2019. Since it was first discovered, there have been confirmed more than 6.18 million cases of Covid-19 worldwide and caused more than 104,000 deaths. Until now, the best method that is considered the standard for detecting Covid-19 is the RT-PCR method. However, due to various resource limitations, especially in underdeveloped areas, the RT-PCR method is sometimes difficult to implement. One alternative solution that is being offered is to apply deep learning-based image processing technology for the initial diagnosis of disease. This study aims to develop a deep learning model based on the CNN algorithm by utilizing chest X-ray images that can be used in the early diagnosis of Covid-19. Several variations of the CNN algorithm architecture that are implemented are EfficientNet, Inception MobileNetV2, ResNet and Xception. This architecture is then modified by adding several additional layers to improve its performance. Based on several experiments that have been carried out, it was found that the application of this modified architecture succeeded in surpassing previous research with an average accuracy rate of above 95%.

articleTitle: Optimizing Tabu List in Tabu Search Algorithm for Efficient and Optimal Scheduling
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Scheduling is one of the essential processes that every organization must carry out to achieve organizational goals. Scheduling problems can occur in various organizations, especially with significant resources such as companies, governments, and educational institutions. SMP IT As Salam Malang has 8 classes, scheduling subjects is a complicated problem that always occurs at the beginning of each semester. Now the scheduling process at SMP IT As Salam Malang is still running manually using Microsoft Excel. This research was created to facilitate the scheduling process at SMP IT As Salam Malang. This research uses the Tabu Search algorithm to carry out the process of scheduling subjects. In the Tabu Search method, the initial solution in a schedule is randomly generated, then the final solution is sought. Tabu List optimization is a collection of steps in the form of an array which is the solution to the lesson schedule with the most negligible total penalty for each iteration. The testing has a full penalty of 202 for scheduling 8 classes.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation of Encryption Algorithms: A Study of 22 Performance Tests
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Encrypting private information is a critical step in preventing unauthorized access or reading. However, selecting a trustworthy encryption technique is crucial. While many encryption algorithms are produced yearly, only a few established methods exist to assess their performance. Some examples of such methods include GB/f 32915-2016 from SCA, SP 800-22 from NIST, and AIS 20 and AIS 31 from BSI. These methods only do fifteen tests, which may need more to determine how well the encryption scheme works. This study aims to propose a software programmer1 that can assess the efficacy of any encryption scheme by running its encrypted data through a series of twenty-two tests. To do this, the proposed software is built oo top d’ the Tinker framework based on the Python programming language. The proposed software is tested by evaluating the performance of five different encryption methods: AES, ARC4, RSA, Logistic Map, and SHA-512 with twenty tests. Featuring a user-friendly interface and effortless encryption algorithm evaluation, the proposed software can guide you in making the optimal choice to assess the performance of encryption algorithms.

articleTitle: Development of the Solar Cell on-grid System 40wp as a Learning Tool for Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The limitations of solar cell learning media are a challenge for higher education in increasing student competence in the field of renewable energy. Solar Cell learning media innovation with an on-grid system is the development of a learning tool for renewable energy. The development of a 40wp on-grid system solar cell trainer kit as a learning tool for renewable energy is the goal of this research. This trainer kit is equipped with an automatic tracking system using LDR. The research method uses research and development with the ADDIE model. The research subjects were 30 students of Electrical Engineering at Surabaya State University. Based on the results of practicality and effectiveness analysis tests, the 40wp on grid solar cell system trainer kit has the feasibility of being used in learning. The results of practicality based on validation and reliability tests on aspects of media and material aspects are categorized as having practicality. The results of the socialization of the trainer kit based on user responses obtained an average of 93.33% which is very effective and needed in learning. The learning outcomes at this trial stage show an increase in competency with 100% complete learning.

articleTitle: Linear Controller Design using Pole Placement Method for Nonholonomic Mobile Robot Trajectory Tracking
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: This work proposes a stable tracking control rule for nonholonomic mobile robot. A closed-loop linearized system model is presented. The feedback controller gains (driving, lateral, and angular) are computed using the pole placement method, where the desired characteristic polynomial equation is compared with the system characteristic polynomial. The poles of the desired characteristic polynomial are located in the stable region of the complex plane. The time varying controller parameters are proposed to overcome undesired system response due to high gain in the lateral direction. The proposed method has been simulated. Satisfactory performances of the trajectory tracking have been verified from simulation results.

articleTitle: Improving Coal Commodity Stock Price Forecasting Using Combined Linear Models via Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: As a consequence of the geopolitical issues that have developed as a direct result of the conflict between Russia and Ukraine, such as the energy crisis that has afflicted a number of European nations, coal stocks have become one of the most profitable investment sectors. This study aims to develop a combined forecast based on Triple Exponential Smoothing (TES) and Seasonal Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (SARIMA) via Artificial Neural Network (ANN) in the coal stock price. This research utilized the daily stock of ADRO, UNTR, and ITMG from January 1, 2022, to October 20, 2022. The result showed that the combined model via ANN always outperforms TES and SARIMA for each variable in the 22-day forecast horizon. Meanwhile, for the individual model, TES has better accuracy performance than SARIMA in ADRO and UNTR with SMAPE 2.81% and 5.48%. More investigations ought to explore the other combined techniques, such as the Bayesian moving average and regression. It might develop into a significant subject of research in the future.

articleTitle: Mitigating Partial Shading Effects in Photovoltaic Arrays using a Switch Matrix: Design, Modeling, and Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Partial shading can significantly reduce the overall power output of PV systems due to the mismatch in irradiance levels across different solar modules. Static and dynamic array reconfigurations are reasonable solutions to reduce the partial shading effect and boost the array power harvesting. This article aims to investigate the effectiveness of a switch matrix system in mitigating the adverse effects of partial shading on photovoltaic (PV) arrays. The study proposes the use of a switch matrix to dynamically reconfigure the interconnections between PV modules, thereby minimizing power losses and improving system efficiency. The experiment involves the design and modeling of the switch matrix, followed by a comprehensive performance evaluation to assess its effectiveness in shading mitigation. For the Performance evaluation, many statistical metrics are used: 1) Mismatch power losses ML (%), 2) Fill factor FF (%), and 3) efficiency $\eta$ (%). The results of the experiments and the analyses showed that the proposed reconfiguration scheme successfully reduced the impact of partial shading on PV arrays.

articleTitle: Implementation of Convolutional Neural Network in the Development of Object Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Education, which is the key to success, is often the most valuable inheritance from parents to children. Not infrequently parents are willing to spend a lot of money for the best education for their children. Early Childhood Education which is early education for children does not escape special attention for parents. Rapid child development begins at this stage. In the final era of the Covid-19 pandemic, digital learning applications are expected to be a bridge and a solution to improve children’s education, especially in the preschool period. One of the abilities of early childhood that needs to be honed is the introduction of objects around them. This object socialization activity also needs to be supported by object recognition applications to help parents or teachers improve children’s abilities. Therefore, we propose an Object Recognition System (OR-Sys) that is connected to a camera to help children recognize objects around them. The image recognition process of surrounding objects requires a reliable classification method. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which is the latest development of the Neural Network method, can adopt and improve the advantages possessed by previous methods, especially in terms of classification. In this study, we choose to use two CNN architectures that are quite popular in use, namely GoogLeNet and ResNet. Both architectures play an important role in the success of OR-Sys in carrying out its duties. This can be seen from the high level of accuracy generated by two architectures, which are 91,4% for GoogLeNet and 94,8% for ResNet.

articleTitle: Conception and simulation of Quadruple Frequency Microstrip Patch Antenna for 4G and 5G Wireless Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Modern wireless communication systems and networks rely heavily on microstrip multiband patch antennas. They are used in a variety of applications, from consumer electronics to industrial and automotive systems, thanks to their combination of compactness, frequency flexibility, integration ease, and planar design. In this article, we outline the procedure of designing and simulating a microstrip patch antenna with the ability to operate in the 900MHz, 1800MHz, 2100MHz, and 3600MHz wireless mobile frequency bands. The GSM, DCS, PCS, UMTS, LTE, and 5G frequency bands are all covered by the designed microstrip antenna. The simulation of our microstrip patch antenna and its many characteristics, including return loss, gain, radiation pattern, and VSWR, served as the foundation for this article. The substrate for the radiating patch is FR4_epoxy, which has a dielectric constant of 4.4. The CST STUDIO program was used for all simulations, which demonstrated that the antenna performed well and that the outcomes were optimal for each frequency. The proposed study is appropriate and useful for enhancing the performance of numerous new mobile microstrip antenna technologies for 4G and 5G telephony.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of 2-DOF Arm Manipulator Robot as Robotic Kinematic Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Technological developments have impacts and challenges in human life. Technological advances have made human life easier. The impact of technological developments is the industrial manufacturing process getting faster with the help of robotics technology. Robots can shorten manufacturing process time and efficient. On the other hand, challenges with technological developments force us to keep learning and adaptive to every changes around us, especially in the education sector. In education sector, formal educational institutions or campuses must be able to facilitate students to be able to learn comprehensively in the field of technology, especially robotics, where we can make an innovative learning platform based on robotics technology. In this study, we discussed a 2-DOF arm manipulator robot as kinematics learning platform of industrial robot to increase student competencies in preparation for facing the industrial environment in century. Inverse kinematics equation has been applied in the robot by providing input coordinates on the x-axis and y-axis where the accuracy value on the x-axis is 77% and the accuracy on the y-axis is 83.1%.

articleTitle: Battery Charge Controller Using Artificial Neural Network-PI (ANN-PI) Algorithm for Various Voltages Rate
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Seen from track record the battery development is classified as very rapid. Batteries are needed by the majority in the field of renewable energy, electric vehicles, and other electrical devices. However, to reduce battery waste which will cause new problems, there are now many batteries circulating rechargeable instead of disposable batteries. Each battery rechargeable has various specifications. These specifications include voltage charging, battery capacity, and also current charging. The battery has a variety of specifications, each battery has an adapter charger different too. Therefore, this research created a system of battery charging controller which can charge the battery with different specifications without many adaptors. On the system is used SEPIC (Single Ended Primary Inductance Converter) Converter with settings duty cycle to generate voltage output which varies. There are four variations of the battery with different specifications. Charging is not done simultaneously, only one battery only. Output current and output voltage will be used as input algorithm Artificial Neural Network (ANN) to perform battery identification and determination set point. Then, PI control stabilize the output in the form of set points. And the method of charging which is used on the system is constant voltage. The system will provide an output voltage of 28.8volt for charging a 24volt battery, 14.4volt for charging a 12volt battery, 7.2volt for charging a 6volt battery, and 8.88volt for charging a 7.4volt battery. Obtained, the average output voltage error is 1.045% for the PI control and 0.13% for the ANN-PI control method for charging on four batteries with varying voltages.

Author Keywords: (Single Ended Primary Inductance Converter) SEPIC converter

articleTitle: Fractional Order Proportional Integral Derivative Based On Sea Horse-Optimizer As DC Motor Control
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Due to their widespread application in numerous types of electronic equipment, DC motors are a hot issue. Therefore, a quick and trustworthy control is needed. With the discovery of various new techniques, the development of optimized control approaches is accelerating. An optimization technique called Sea Horse optimizer (SHO) is based on the interactions of sea horses with other living things. In this article, we’ll discuss how to enhance fractional order PID (FOPID) control on DC motors using the SHO technique. Because the fractional calculus operators used by the FOPID controller cannot be used directly in numerical calculations, implementing the FOPID controller is equally challenging. The FOPID-SHO approach is the one that this article suggests. The standard PID and Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) are two of the comparison methodologies used in this work to evaluate the performance of the suggested method. The performance of the suggested strategy is also measured in this investigation using a different reference speed. The results of the trial show that the FOPID-SHO approach performs at the highest level. When compared to the conventional method, the FOPID-SHO method overshoots by 0.466%.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Hand Gesture Exergames for Dementia Development Suppression
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: According to the World Health Organization (WHO), currently, more than 55 million people around the world are suffering from dementia. To suppress the development of dementia, hand exercises may take important roles. While playing video games can improve brain functions by concentrating and enjoying them. Then, exergames of playing video games with hand gestures will be very helpful for dementia patients. Based on this motivation, we have studied hand gesture exergames that run on conventional personal computers with web browsers. By using the Python Mediapipe program, the games are controlled by hand gestures. In this paper, we define four hand gestures corresponding to key presses to control the game and prepare four hand gesture exergames by downloading the codes from the Internet. For evaluations, we asked 10 students at Okayama University, Japan, to play them and answer the questions on the usability questionnaires. The results confirm the validity of the proposal. In the next steps, we will evaluate them by seniors including dementia patients.

articleTitle: An Improve KNN Method for Classification of Sexually Transmitted Diseases
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: This Sexually Transmitted Diseases (STD) are diseases caused by infections that are transmitted through sexual contact. One way to overcome the problem of sexually transmitted diseases is to create an application that can help people in early detection. One method that can analyze PMS based on its symptoms is the K-NN method. However, the K-NN method still produces 90% accuracy using venereal disease datasets. Several ways to improve the accuracy of this method include using different distance calculations and using weights as calculations, one of which is by improving KNN. In this study, the WBCKNN modification was carried out on the same dataset, namely the venereal disease dataset. Modification of this method is done by adding leave-one-out cross-validation (LOOCV), without LOOCV, undersampling and oversampling. The proposed algorithm is evaluated and compared with the KNN, WKNN, BCKNN methods that have been analyzed previously. This study shows that the WBCKNN method is effective with an accuracy of 94.24% without LOOVC, the addition of LOOCV produces an accuracy of 90.70%, with the data type undersampling without LOOVC produces an accuracy of 99.90% and oversampling without LOOVC produces an accuracy of 98.47%. In this study the WBCKNN method produced high accuracy compared to the previous method.

articleTitle: Tracking Position on GPS Smart Buoy System Using LoRa Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The use of buoy navigation aids is crucial for directing ships through perilous waterways. As a navigational aid, it is crucial to preserving the functionality of the system and the safety of the assets. One of the buoy assets is a lamp which has a fairly high price. Buoy can be supported by the use of Internet of Things technology in order to be able to guarantee the safety of assets. IoT applications are widely employed in many industries, including the monitoring industry. The LoRaWAN wireless network is now being used by the technology that is being developed for IoT device connectivity. This technology makes it possible to communicate over long distances of up to more than 500 meters. In this study, LoRa communication will be used to create a buoy position monitoring system with LoRaWAN protocol. This technology makes use of a GPS sensor to get coordinates from the buoy in real-time. From one of the longitude and latitude data collected in buoys 1(−6.918378, 112.726867) and 2(−6.968248, 112.709147), which were obtained during testing at sea and where coordinates are in the ocean in accordance with the buoy position. Data from sensors will be transmitted to the Antares platform utilizing LoRa 915 MHz using the ESP32 microcontroller. The result of packet loss on the buoy monitoring system is 6.7%.

articleTitle: Feedback Analysis of Learning Evaluation Applications using Latent Dirichlet Allocation
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The lecturer’s evaluation by a student (EDOM) application facilitates collecting anonymous feedback from students regarding their respective lecturers at the end of each semester. This feedback plays a vital role in evaluating teaching quality, identifying areas for improvement, and fostering a constructive learning environment. In this study, we propose leveraging the Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) algorithm to analyze the substantial volume of student feedback data. The LDA algorithm offers an advanced solution for extracting topics from large document datasets, overcoming the challenges associated with laborious and time-consuming manual analysis. By applying the LDA algorithm to analyze 31,600 student feedback records, our experimental testing yielded a coherence score of 0.4, indicating the interpretability and coherence of the generated topics. The findings revealed significant topics, including students’ desire for enhanced learning experiences and suggestions for teaching methods. These insights offer valuable input for lecturers to improve their instructional practices and create a more engaging learning environment. Additionally, this study presents noteworthy experiments that determined the optimal topic modeling based on the number of topics, iterations, and relevance metrics.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Optical Fiber Network Deployment on Trans Sulawesi Railway via Makassar-Parepare
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The Indonesian Government has prioritized the development of rail transportation as an efficient and effective mode of mass transportation. Rail transportation offers high capacity, reliable travel times, fuel savings, low exhaust emissions, and connectivity to economic centers. The Ministry of Transportation has initiated an accelerated development plan for rail transportation, including the Trans Sulawesi National Railway Network. The Makassar-Parepare route is part of this project, connecting five cities/regencies in South Sulawesi, covering a distance of 142 km and featuring 16 stations. The railway reduces travel time from 3 hours to 1.5 hours and contributes to increased efficiency, capacity, employment, and reduced traffic congestion. To ensure safety and regulate traffic, a fiber optic-based signaling system is proposed, offering higher connection speeds, longer transmission distances, flexibility, and resistance to electromagnetic interference. This paper analyzes the feasibility and potential impacts of implementing fiber optics in the Trans Sulawesi railway communication system using a power link budget and rise time budget analysis. The deployment aims to improve infrastructure quality and accelerate digital transformation in Indonesia. Based on the proposed optical fiber network design, the power link budget shows that the received power ranges from −14.439 to −21.115 dBm, which is still above the receiver sensitivity level of −24dBm. The rise time system at each station ranges from 40.283 to 49.315 ps, with a maximum acceptable dispersion limit of 4501.03 ps. With these parameters, the proposed system design ensures the proper functioning of the entire signaling and telecommunications equipment system.

articleTitle: Classification via Clustering for Subject-based Scientific Fields in Kindergarten Students
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The concern of teachers and parents to maximize the potential of their children’s golden years is a common phenomenon. Exploring this potential is usually based on a prominent child’s scientific field. This is certainly not easy to do because of the many subjects taken when children attend early childhood education. This problem is crucial and needs to be solved. However, research related to this has not been done much. Therefore, this study focuses on classification via clustering the scientific fields of kindergarten children based on the subjects. The clustering task is done using the K-means method. Then, the classification task is applied by using 2 methods, namely: Random Forest and Support Vector Classifier (SVC). The implementation of these methods to obtain optimal model performance. The experimental results show that the highest performance model can be generated by the proposed method. This is indicated by the optimal model, in terms of the accuracy level, which achieved about 100%. This best performance of the model is built by the K-means-SVC method with a training data size of 80% and 85%.

articleTitle: A Modified Design Of The Gas Flow Channel Model For The Proton Exchange Membrane Fuel Cells: A Three-Dimensional Simulation
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: This research examines how PEM fuel cell are affected by changes in the Gas Flow Channel’s geometry. In this study, observations were made of pressure drop and velocity contours by adjusting the configuration of the gas flow channel shape in the hope of having a low-pressure drop and even distribution of reactants. The gas flow channel shape used was a mixture of parallel and serpentine shapes. The shape variations used are parallel-serpentine and parallel-serpentine-parallel. The CFD method was employed in this research, and the analysis was performed using CFD software. Some of the parameters used in this study include pressure drop with velocity variations and velocity contours. The simulation results of the Gas Flow Channel parallel-serpentine-parallel model show that the greater the velocity, the greater the pressure drop from the inlet to the outlet. The parallel-serpentine-parallel shape variation has a lower pressure drop than other shape variations with an inlet velocity of 1 m/s in terms of the pressure drop parameters.

articleTitle: Analysis of CO Pollutant Monitoring System Using MAPPI32 LORA in Bekasi City
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Air pollution in the form of particles and gases that are caused by both results in unhealthy air quality. The health index standard notes that 0-50 in units of $\mu$g/m3 is the threshold for clean and beautiful air. With the increasingly massive technology era, researchers are trying to compare the results of monitoring the pollutant gas carbon monoxide (CO) at two points in Bekasi City. Researchers used a simple design model with the LoRa WAN concept to develop the application. The variables studied were knowing the sensitivity of the MQ135 gas sensor and CO gas levels by the MQ135 sensor using Mappi32 in real-time. To design and build a monitoring system using LoRa (Long Range) Communication and also to apply a system for monitoring LoRa (Long Range) Communication Network-Based Air Pollution. The Transmitter-a and Transmitter-b obtained are $CO_{a}$ Gas of 14.63 % and $CO_{b}$ Gas of 11.08%. The % Accuracy sensor compare to the manufacturer’s tool in COa Gas sensor is 85,37 % and COb Gas sensor 88,92% with $10^{{\mathrm {th}}}$ time comparation condition. The MAPE value is range 10% until 20%, the modeling ability of the tool is good in the measurement of CO gas (Carbon Monoxide). From the ISPU calculation results, $CO_{a}$ Gas and $CO_{b}$ Gas detected by the sensor for 24 hours were 92.19 $\mu$g/m3 and 93.22 $\mu$g/m3, respectively, so they are included in the moderate ISPU category.

articleTitle: Activation Function Comparison On Potato Leaf Disease Classification Performance
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Indonesia is a country with agriculture and food crops potential. The agricultural production index in 2021 has grown in comparison to 2020 based on these three plant categories, with food crops reaching 92.51, horticultural crops at 121.39, and plantation crops at 161.85. A food crop called the potato (Solanum tuberosum L.) is utilized in Indonesia as a vegetable and is frequently used in processed food, homes, fast food company, and flour and chip company. Attacks from pests and diseases are one of the contributing elements to the current fall in potato crop productivity. The ability to diagnose illnesses more quickly and with greater accuracy has been made possible by technological advancements. One method for detecting potato leaf disease is artificial intelligence (AI). Unbalanced data is another issue, where the relative data sets proportionate class sizes diverge by a significant enough margin. Data processing for imbalanced or oversampled data is necessary to avoid this. A method for combining various data classes to get a balanced data collection is oversampling. This method is known as data pre-processing. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method will be used to process the data after it has been balanced. CNN are a type of deep learning algorithm. The CNN approach uses many processing layers to identify and extract data features. More than one convolution layer can be used by CNN to build complicated features from the network’s initial simple features. The goal of the study was to use potato leaf image data based on three class, including potato plants with healthy, early blight, and late blight to diagnose illnesses with the greatest accuracy to farmers or agriculture department. The steps in the methodology are choosing the optimal activation, optimizer, and epoch functions to compare, selecting the best potato dataset, pre-processing, splitting the data for training and testing, determining the classification using CNN, and accuracy. The proposed method delivers accuracy on the potato leaf diseases with an accuracy of 98.33% with a 3X3 kernel, ADAM optimizer, activation function ReLu, and epoch 250.

articleTitle: Design of a Prototype of a Hand Bionic Prosthesis with Independent Mobility and Three-Dimensional Rotation of the Wrist Controlled by sEMG Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The present research consists of the mechanical and electronic design of a hand prosthesis that is composed of a parallel robot platform to perform the movement of the wrist, on this platform 3 universal joints will be mounted that will be connected to the base of 3 linear actuators that represent a prismatic joint for the extension and flexion movement of which will be controlled by an Arduino Mega type board. The design of the prosthesis consists of a base that represents the palm of the hand joined to the proximal phalanx, which will be attached to the medial phalanx and finally attached to the distal phalanx assembled by means of mechanical couplings that will represent the fingers of a human hand, the mechanism for its movement will be through the medial internal link and proximal internal link to the interior of each finger interconnecting each phalanx and finally connected to the terminal link that is attached to the axis of the MG90S servo motor, that will allow the mobility of the links and in turn of the phalanges. Likewise, for the individual mobility of the thumb, a proximal internal link is used inside, 2 servomotors for the lateral and contralateral opposition of the thumb. These actuators will be controlled by the same microcontroller mentioned above. For the drive of the motors, EMG sensors are used to capture the user’s intention of movement through muscle pulses of the residual limb, the methodology applied for this design is based on three stages (mechanical stage, electronic stage and the integrative stage). As a result, it is obtained that the design of the prosthesis achieves the independent movements of each finger and wrist, also the good communication of the sensors and actuators.

articleTitle: A Prototype Development and Implementation of a Fast Lithium Battery Packs Active On-Load Balancing System
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Lithium-ion (Li-ion) batteries are frequently used in electric vehicles, portable electronics, and renewable energy storage systems due to their long cycle life and high energy density. Nevertheless, battery cell imbalance caused by varying discharge rates and temperature gradients limits Li-ion battery packs’ lifespan and performance. A potential method called smart active on-load balancing (SALB) can reduce cell imbalance by spreading the charge across individual cells as they discharge. In this paper, a comprehensive study of the performance and benefits of SALB for Li-ion battery packs is presented. A pilot experimentally investigates the effects of SALB on cell voltage and capacity balance, temperature distribution, and cycle life. The results demonstrate that SALB significantly improves cell balance, reduces temperature gradients, and extends the cycle life of Li-ion battery packs. SALB also enhances the efficiency and overall performance of battery systems, making it a promising technique for boosting the lifespan of Li-ion battery packs in electric vehicles and renewable energy storage systems.

articleTitle: Towards Personalized Fitness with Multi-modal Wearable Heart Rate Monitors: A Proposal
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Nowadays, the trend for home workouts is getting more and more popular. The growth of wearable fitness trackers from basic accelerometers, pedometers, pulse detectors, and ECGs also supports the advancement of personal fitness monitoring. Everyone has a distinct level of fitness, in theory. The heart rate, which is correlated with physical activity, such as sports, demonstrates how this organ functions. As the muscles work harder at a high intensity, the heart rate will also rise. This paper presents the design and implementation of a multimodal wearable heart rate monitoring system. The software is Android-based and is designed to be able to receive heart rate data sent by two different wearable heart rate monitors simultaneously using Bluetooth low-energy protocol. One uses an optical heart monitor and the other uses an electrocardiogram or ECG. The implementation also includes IoT for real-time data acquisition and a web-based application for wider accessibility. The system is evaluated by collecting packets from two devices for 60 minutes. The results underscore the feasibility of the system in collecting users’ heart rate data either using different devices. Furthermore, it serves as a foundation for future studies aiming to expand the personalization capabilities of wearable devices in healthcare and fitness.

articleTitle: Identifying Strawberry Ripeness Level Using Camera for Cartesian Robot Application Based on Microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: In this paper, we present a method for identifying strawberry ripeness levels using a camera for a Cartesian robot application. An automatic strawberry picking system has been developed to help simplify and speed up the harvesting process for farmers. The identification of fruit color is one of the fastest ways to identify the ripeness of strawberries. Automatically picking fruit using a robot has been widely developed to make it easier for farmers. Researchers have designed a system for identifying the ripeness of strawberries based on color using a camera, which will be applied to a Cartesian robot. The fruit color identification system considers the value of RGB taken by the camera, when the strawberry is identified as ripe, the Cartesian moves to pick the fruit. The results of the system’s testing in identifying and picking fruit showed the fastest time was 6 seconds, and the longest time was 43 seconds. The success rate was 87.5%, because the strawberries are not identified as ripe because they are still raw. It is hoped that the system will help farmers pick strawberries automatically.

articleTitle: A High Accurate Multi Objective Hunger Games Search Algorithm for Environmental Economic Dispatch Issues
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel multi-objective hunger games search algorithm (MOHGS) with a keen focus on optimal power flow determination. The primary goal of this approach is to minimize critical factors: the generation cost, power losses, and environmental emissions within the realm of economic dispatch. This algorithm was judiciously applied to a standard system - the IEEE 30 bus. Subsequent evaluations were carried out using the MATLAB software, and the results were benchmarked against a series of diverse case studies to underline its effectiveness. The data reflects MOHGS's proficiency; for instance, in Case #1, the fuel cost stands at ${\$}$833.4/h with emissions at 0.24 ton/h and an actual power loss of 5.1 MW. Similarly, in Case #6, the fuel expenditure is noted at ${\$}$967/h, with an emission level of 0.22 ton/h and a power loss of 3.4 MW. These findings not only reiterate MOHGS's capability in managing voltage stability index, actual power loss, emission volumes, and generation fuel costs but also spotlight its potential as a pivotal tool in power systems optimization.

articleTitle: The Design and Implementation of a Waypoint-Based Autonomous Control System on a Low-Level Controller for Self-Driving Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Autonomous land transportation vehicles and Electric Vehicles (EV) have become the main choice of the majority of society due to their environmentally friendly nature. Furthermore, the acceleration of autonomous vehicle research can also reduce traffic accidents caused by human error, which have been significantly high in the last 10 years. However, the cost required to obtain assistance from autonomous systems still tends to be expensive. This paper presents the development of a device utilizing an Advanced RISC Machine (ARM) Cortex-an Advanced RISC Machine (ARM) Cortex-M4 STM32F411 microcontroller system with 32-bit architecture. This system offers optimal performance at a cost-effective price point. The proposed autonomous system is designed based on the waypoint method as a reference to the vehicle’s position. The Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) accessed through the U-Blox NEO-M8P module provides position data, whereas the HMC5883L magnetometer provides orientation data. The position data is further processed by utilizing a Kalman filter to enhance accuracy and reduce computational burden. The error detection angle read by the E-Compass is only 0.31% with the ground speed testing in comparison with true speed from car odometry with an average error of 1%, thus supporting good data accuracy, achieved with a track error of only 0.06 meters in real-scale environmental testing. This demonstrates the successful implementation of autonomous control algorithms on the low-level controller.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of Smart Nano Grid System in Intelligent Grid Integration for Energy Independent Campus Realization
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Implementation of renewable energy, especially solar energy, serves new challenges to the existing traditional grid. The electric energy generated from the sun is converted to AC current with an inverter to supply loads on the grid. However, the inverter connected to the grid must synchronized with the grid. The grid system requires advanced technologies to integrate the PV. This research aims to develop a prototype of smart nano grid 1 kW using PV as distributed generator. The method used is experimental design method which consists of design & modelling process, breadboarding, laboratory test, prototyping, small-field test, evaluation, and analysis. According to the test, the conclusions are the prototype is able to convert DC to AC output 220V, capable of supplying the loads up to 5A AC with power factor approaching 1, and highly efficient in battery consumption which makes the prototype is eligible to be applied in campus buildings with high demands of electricity.

articleTitle: Development Modified Long Short Term Memory Model For Prediction Power Electrical Photovoltaic on Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: A novelty using the modified Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) modeling for optimized prediction of very short-term power electrical using input variable weather data with a development LSTM method. This modeling is a development-modified LSTM method. The modified LSTM model is designed to forecast power electrical 1 hours ahead of basic meteorology data for the Photovoltaic (PV) generation station on-grid. The proposed research of this modified LSTM model is taken into account using meteorology data. The method development modified is a preprocessing data to the LSTM method. In the error value of the development-LSTM simulation method, the value mean absolute percentage error value is 0.50/0. The modified Long STM model prediction is then compared to actual data, development decomposition, and results indicate that the Modified-LSTM model presented in the novelty from the proposed study can predict 60 minutes power electrical with optimal accuracy value.

articleTitle: Non-Invasive Measurement of Blood Glucose Levels Using Linear Regression and Clark Error Grid Analysis Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Glucose flowing through the blood is the source of energy for body cells. Blood glucose levels indicate the sugar concentration in the blood, which needs to be strictly regulated to maintain a healthy body. Blood glucose levels can be measured non-invasively using the concept of oximetry measurement. Oximetry measurement is performed using an infrared emitting diode and a photodiode sensor, which is attached to the finger to measure the oxygen content in the blood (SpO2 value). Then, the SpO2 data was processed using the linear and log natural regression equation and analyzed using the Clarke Error Grid Analysis method to obtain the characteristics and correlation between oxygen content and glucose levels in the blood. This research shows that the predicted blood glucose level value are different from the reference blood glucose level value by more than 20%. This zone is closer to medically erroneous blood glucose values, but medical surveillance has a high probability of being accurate.

articleTitle: Development of Be-Braille Learning Tool: Enhancing Braille Education and Interaction for Visually Impaired Students
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: As technology advances in Indonesia, the view emerges that visually impaired children can simply utilize adaptive technology available in the market. This is because not everyone can be facilitated by adaptive technology. Another challenge in teaching reading and writing to visually impaired children is the limited number of teachers in special schools who understand Braille, as well as the limited availability of tools such as reglet and stylus. There is one electronic device used by visually impaired individuals to read text in Braille, namely the Refreshable Braille display consisting of 24 cells priced at 3600 euros or approximately equivalent to 53 million Indonesian Rupiah. Therefore, a low-cost portable Braille device that can be owned by every special school is needed. This research utilizes the ESP32 microcontroller to control a 5V relay in order to move the Braille keys. When the inductance in the relay changes, the frequency also changes, converting it into voltage to control the up and down movement of the Braille keys according to the data sent. Input in the form of letters or numbers is transmitted to a smartphone as a human-machine interface using Bluetooth.

articleTitle: Performance Prediction and Waveform Properties of Passive Coherent Location Radar Systems in the Tarakan Area
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Passive Coherent Location (PCL) System Radar is a variant of bistatic radar that exploits its illuminator as a source of radar transmission. The many of radio frequency (RF) illuminators in an area such as Tarakan in the form of FM radio (Pro-2 RRI), Digital TV (TVRI), cellphone base-station (4G-LTE), Wi-Fi, and so on have the potential to act as PCL. It is known that PCL can be considered as a radar system considering its advantages such as low cost without an active transmitter, support for various target measurements, anti-detectable electronic counter measures (EMC), and so on. This paper will provide performance predictions and analyze the waveform properties for the PCL illuminator. Performance prediction as a means of demonstrating the detection of range coverage is useful for predicting the whereabouts of targets. While analysis of waveform properties provides resolution and ambiguity function of the range and Doppler as the principal parameters of the radar. The results show that Pro-2 RRI with FM transmission has the farthest range of up to 12 km for a maximum SNR of 15 dB, 4G-LTE transmission has the smallest range resolution of 1606.5 m. Meanwhile, the smallest Doppler resolution obtained by TVRI transmission is ±300 Hz.

articleTitle: Multi-Inverter Coordinated Control on AC Microgrid for Increased Load Power
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: At present the need for AC power loads is increasing in accordance with the increasing population. This is due to the increasing electrical load that requires an AC power source. In addition, fossil fuels are getting less and less and many power plants use these fossil sources. Indonesia is a country that has abundant sources of renewable energy, so that microgrids can be developed. In the microgrid system, the inverter is used to convert DC voltage to AC voltage. The purpose of this research is to increase the stability of the availability of AC sources. In this article, a multi-inverter coordinated control strategy is proposed for controlling the load power flow by using three photovoltaic (PV) arrays and each connected to a single-phase inverter. Coordinated control uses a Fuzzy Logic Controller (FLC) with three inputs and one output. Each input and output uses five membership functions. The FLC input is inverter A, inverter B, and inverter C, while the output is AC bus. The results of the study with coordinated control using FLC provide a stable output frequency of 50 Hz, while the PI controller produces a change in output frequency from 0.05 seconds to 0.35 seconds. Therefore, the AC load needs to be supplied quickly using FLC within 0.01 seconds, while the PI controller supplies power to the load within 0.15 seconds.

articleTitle: Development of SQL Similarity with Multiple Answer Keys for the Automated Assessment Process in the SQLearn Application
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Automated assessment plays an important role in computer science education especially in basic database subjects. Using automated assessment decreased the workload of a lecturer and increase student participation and engagement while learning database. In this study we propose to use a multiple answer key and similarity check using tf-idf and cosine similarity in our SQLearn automated assessment system. The experiment involves 20 sophomore computer science students that learn to create queries using SQLearn system. From this experiment we obtain 453 queries created by students, we use SQLearn to automatically assess the student’s answers using both single key answer and multiple key answers to measure the accuracy of SQLearn. By adding the multiple keys answer the SQLearn shows an optimum accuracy of 92.20% in 60% to 70% similarity threshold, this accuracy was increased 7.8% compared to single key system. The results also shown that the accuracy increased following the increased of provided key answer in this experiment we recommend minimum three answer keys for one question. By utilizing multiple answer key similarity check in SQLearn we can improve the accuracy of the assessment while reducing lecturer workload.

articleTitle: Optimizing Low Power Solar Power Plants through the Implementation of a SEPIC-CUK Combination Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: A power converter is a device designed to transform electrical energy from one form to another, primarily to align with the distinct requirements of various loads or energy sources. In this study, we conducted tests on photovoltaic (PV) systems utilizing a combination of the SEPIC-CUK converters. Both SEPIC and CUK converters belong to the category of DC/DC converters capable of effecting voltage conversions, be it step-up or step-down. Our testing encompassed variations in sunlight intensity, temperature fluctuations, and a comparative analysis of PV systems operating with and without Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT). The ensuing test results were subjected to in-depth analysis to assess the performance of the combined SEPICCUK converter. Furthermore, the performance of this converter was juxtaposed with that of SEPIC converters integrated into the same system. The evaluation hinged on the comparison of PV output power achieved with and without the application of an MPPT controller. Notably, the outcomes of these assessments revealed that, under conditions of $1000\mathrm{W}/ \mathrm{m}^{2}$ radiation and a temperature of 25°C, the output power without MPPT control amounted to 52.33 Watts. Conversely, when an MPPT controller was employed under identical conditions, the power output surged to 81.77 Watts. These findings underscore the efficacy of utilizing a controller in optimizing PV power output.

articleTitle: New Approach Motion Determination in Pencak Silat Sport using Self Organizing Map
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Pencak Silat is a sport that not only pays attention to the strength factor but also cultural and spiritual elements. This is what makes Pencak Silat one of the cultural heritages of Indonesia. In order not to become extinct, efforts are needed, one of which is given a touch of technology in the practice of Pencak Silat matches. The aim of this research is implementing the Self Organizing Map in determining the type of Pencak Silat movement. The movements that will be identified are punches, kicks, and defence. This is important because the determination of the score depends on the movement of punches, kicks, and defence did by the athlete. This research consists of several stages, namely collecting data on smart pirates, processing data statistically, carrying out the learning process using a Self Organizing Map, conducting the testing stage, and conducting the evaluation stage. Data collection was carried out primarily by involving 6 people (there were 3 pairs of matches) to perform limited punches, kicks, and parries. Each person does 10 punches, 10 kicks, and 10 parries. So the total data is 180 data. The method used is Self Organizing Map with a learning rate of 0.8 and the number of epochs in the learning process is 1000 epochs. The results show that the system has determined the motion well, supported by the accuracy value during the testing process. The accuracy value obtained is 74.444% for the first and second experiments, and 99.444% for the third experiment.

articleTitle: Predictive Comparative Analysis for Fundamental Risk of U.S Import and Economy Seafood Market
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Future obstacles include the growth of illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) crimes and the presence of a market leader in the US as the main fish importer. Almost of the world's marine fish stocks have already reached total depletion and are in danger of going extinct, according to the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD, 2018). Fishing that is illegal, unreported, and unregulated (IUU) is a serious issue here. The facts indicate that exporting countries engage in (IUU) practices by processing seafood from numerous different fleets. Therefore, smart technology based on innovative data and analytics systems such as Machine Learning technology is needed to enable fully monitored fisheries. This research aims to provide the best analysis method, focusing on the fundamental risk characteristics of marine capture. The research objective is to analyze the performance of the best model and predict high-risk fundamental characteristics in countries exporting to the U.S. The data utilized consists of 115 samples obtained from the United States International Trade Commission (USITC). The results of the method analysis, various algorithms, including K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Logistic Regression, and Decision Tree, were considered for comparison. However, the results indicate that Random Forest stands out as the most effective method, demonstrating the highest predictive capability for high-level fundamental risk. This is evident from the impressive AUC value of 0.993, an Accuracy score of 0.9222, Precision of 0.9510, and Recall value of 0.9571.

articleTitle: Gain Scheduling Control for a Quadrotor Based on Proportional Derivative Controller
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: In this study, a linear PD (proportional-derivative) controller and a PD-based Gain Scheduling Controller are used to regulate the quadrotor’s altitude, attitude, direction, and position in space. The simulation was carried out using the MATLAB/Simulink program, and the objective function was set to reduce the discrepancy between the controlled parameter’s desired and actual values. When operating in hover position, the suggested controllers were successful in stabilizing the quadrotor at the specified altitude. Comparing the gain-scheduling and PD controllers’ capacities to follow a changing altitude and attitude trajectory.

articleTitle: Voltage Regulation of Buck Converter in DC microgrid using Energy Valley Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Buck converter is basic component and main control of DC voltage regulator in DC microgrid. In this paper, an energy valley optimizer (EVO) used to tune gains of proportional integral (PI) controller for voltage regulation of buck converter is proposed. The new metaheuristic algorithm EVO is inspired by stability and various particle decay modes in advanced physics. To verify the superiority of the proposed method, numerical simulation is carried out. Furthermore, the proposed method is compared by several metaheuristic methods and assessed by two system tests including input voltage and load variation. Simulation results indicate the proposed method has the better performance such as lower overshoot and shorter recovery time than other metaheuristic methods. Additionally, integral absolute error (IAE) of proposed method is smaller compared to others.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of The PV Array Based on Hybrid Configuration Under Variable Irradiance Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The study investigates the challenges posed by" partial shading conditions" (PSCs) on a performance and efficiency of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems. The primary goal is to find the best photovoltaic array setup to optimize power output while reducing efficiency losses caused by mismatching. The researchers evaluate various PV configurations such as Series (S), Series-Parallel (SP), Total Cross Tied (TCT), Bridge Linked (BL), Honey Comb (HC), and a hybrid of TCT and BL called TCT-BL, focusing on a 4x4 array layout. Six different shading patterns are examined, including diagonal, "short and narrow", "short and wide", "long and narrow", "long and wide", and random. Based on simulations using Matlab/Simulink and a 130W PV module model, the study suggests that the TCT-BL configuration offers superior power generation, efficiency, and reduced mismatching loss compared to other configurations under most PSCs examined.

articleTitle: Application of K-Means Algorithm for Clustering Regions Based on Sanitation Level: A Case Study in Bangka Regency, Indonesia
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Dengue Hemorrhagic Fever (DHF) cases have increased annually, especially in Bangka Regency, Bangka Belitung Islands Province. Environmental sanitation is one factor that also influences the incidence of DHF. This research aims to cluster regions based on sanitation level by applying the K-Means Clustering method. The optimal number of clusters is determined using the Silhouette and Elbow methods. The results of this study indicate that the optimal number of clusters for grouping regions based on the level of sanitation using the elbow method is 3 clusters with an inertia value of 8623.87632779. Whereas in the Silhouette coefficient method, for the same number of clusters, the Silhouette coefficient value is 0.396250. The results of area clustering based on the level of sanitation using the number of clusters of 3 yielded: 112 regions included in Cluster 1 (low sanitation category), 263 regions included in Cluster 2 (medium sanitation category), and 105 regions included in Cluster 3 (high sanitation category). The system performance evaluation using the K-Means Clustering method obtained accuracy = 0.8645, average sensibility = 0.8775, average specificity = 0.9231, and average precision = 0.9176. This indicates that the K-Means method can recognize patterns well and differentiate sanitation levels in various regions. The use of the system with the K-Means Clustering method can support analysis for the government, especially the Bangka District Health Office, in identifying regions based on their level of sanitation, which can be used as a basis for evaluation and formulation of strategic steps to improve sanitation to control or anticipate DHF incidents.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Clustering Method in Gold Price
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Clustering in statistics and fuzzy properties has many methods. One of the clustering types that is commonly used is unsupervised learning. This paper uses fuzzy clustering with the type of clustering is unsupervised learning. There are fuzzy subtractive clustering, fuzzy k-means clustering, and fuzzy c-means clustering. This paper aims to find the best method for clustering the price of gold. Based on existing data that used the initial principal component analysis, this paper uses multivariate data on gold prices from October 2020 to March 2021. The initial analysis can reduce the dimension of data. This paper shows that fuzzy k-means clustering is the best method for this case, with the optimal clustering result indicated by the smaller Davies-Bouldin index value of 0.99075.

articleTitle: Using Sentiment Analysis to Spot Trending Products
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Trend detection refers to the process of recognizing significant patterns or trends within large datasets, including changes over time and seasonal variations. In the context of product-related data, trend product detection is a specialized tool or software that is specifically designed to identify trends in sales, customer preferences, product reviews, and other relevant data points. The study focuses on the combination of trend detection and sentiment analysis as a powerful approach for trend spotting. In this paper, we present a study that uses natural language processing (NLP) techniques and the VADER sentiment analysis tool to identify product sentiment from customer reviews. We then applied decision tree analysis to predict whether a product is likely to trend or not based on its sentiment score. Additionally, we used clustering to group the top-rated products based on their sentiment scores and applied a moving average to determine which products are currently trending. Our results show that the combination of trend detection and sentiment analysis can effectively identify trending products with an accuracy of 93%. This study demonstrates the power of NLP and sentiment analysis in detecting trends and provides valuable insights for businesses to make data-driven decisions about their product offerings.

articleTitle: Recommendation system using Deep Learning-based sentiment analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: With the exponential growth of online data, there is a growing demand for advanced recommendation systems (RS) due to their crucial role in providing personalized item recommendations to users. This work aims to overcome the limitations of traditional RSs by introducing an innovative approach that seamlessly integrates sentiment analysis (SA) into recommender system techniques. The primary goal is to enhance the performance of SA and improve the reliability and accuracy of user recommendations. The suggested framework comprises of three essential steps: SA, where the Bi-GRU technique is utilized to assess the emotional context within user reviews; the generation of personalized recommendations; and the seamless integration of sentiment analysis into the recommendation system. A comprehensive evaluation conducted on a Musical Instruments dataset demonstrates significant improvements in evaluation metrics. The Bi-GRU technique achieves an impressive accuracy rate of 89%. User-based recommendations using SA yield an RMSE of 1.83 and an MAE of 1.71. Additionally, item-based recommendations result in an RMSE of 2.18 and an MAE of 2.00. This pioneering approach represents a substantial contribution, promising more reliable and precise user recommendations, ultimately enhancing overall user satisfaction and the user experience.

articleTitle: A Study of Grammar-concept Understanding Problem for Flutter Cross-platform Mobile Programming Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: With the rapid growth of smartphones and tablets, learning mobile programming has become a crucial skill for students. Mobile app development involves writing a separate codebase for each platform. However, with the advent of cross-platform mobile programming, a paradigm shift has occurred in the mobile development landscape. Learning cross-platform mobile programming concepts and understanding then syntax and grammar can be challenging, especially for beginners. This paper presents an implementation of grammar-concept understanding problem for cross-platform mobile programming learning, explicitly focusing on the Flutter framework. Flutter is a cross-platform framework that allows developers to build native mobile applications using a single codebase. The evaluation of the implementation involved 109 undergraduate students in Makassar State University, Indonesia, who were assigned 22 instances covering 71 carefully selected keywords and questions. The results show that the proposal effectively reveals students understanding levels. These findings contribute to identifying areas for improvement and developing targeted learning resources to enhance mobile programming education.

articleTitle: An Investigation of Running Load Comparisons of ARCore on Native Android and Unity for Outdoor Navigation System Using Smartphone
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: In recent years, the utilization of location-based augmented reality (LAR) has gained popularity across various domains, including tourism, education, gaming, and advertising. The advancements in AR technology have made it easier to develop immersive LAR applications. ARCore, a widely adopted AR development library, enables the creation of location-based AR apps on Android devices. However, the implementation of ARCore in real-time scenarios that demand significant computational resources, like outdoor pedestrian navigation, can vary depending on the chosen development environment. This research aims to explore and compare the running load performance of ARCore implementation in location-based AR applications developed with Unity and Android Native, which are two prevalent AR development platforms. The study involves building a prototype LAR application using both Unity and native Android, followed by comprehensive running load performance evaluations. The findings reveal that while both Unity and native Android apps can deliver compelling location-based AR experiences, native Android apps demonstrate superior performance and resource efficiency in outdoor scenarios, whereas Unity offers the advantage of multi-platform support and ease of development for complex 3D assets. These insights provide valuable guidance to developers in selecting the most suitable approach for developing location-based AR applications for navigation, aligning with their specific needs and requirements.

articleTitle: A Cross-Platform Implementation of Indoor Navigation System Using Unity and Smartphone INSUS
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Indoor navigation systems have become increasingly important for seamless navigation within complex buildings. In this paper, we present the cross-platform implementation of the Indoor Navigation System Using Unity and Smartphone (INSUS), on Android and iOS operating systems. INSUS utilizes augmented reality technology to display arrows to guide users to reach their destination. It employs the Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) technique, combining the gyroscope and camera, to track user movements inside buildings after initializing the location using Quick Response (QR) codes. To ensure accurate results on different platforms we conduct experiments to measure navigation success rates on both. To achieve high accuracy we limit smartphone tilt angle between 80° to 100°. The evaluation results indicate INSUS achieves an average of 95.83% success rate for Android and 93.75% for iOS devices was achieved. It was generally found that INSUS compatible with both operating systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Architecture of Conditional Tabular Generative Adversarial Network and 1D Convolution Neural Network for Enhanced Attack Detection in IoT Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: IoT devices have become essential in various fields, such as industry and healthcare. However, these tools transfer much data, including personal and confidential information. Thus, ensuring the security of IoT devices is crucial to protecting personal data and preventing cyber attacks. Using traditional techniques such as signature or anomaly-based IDS encounters several problems, such as zero-attack detection, which leads researchers to turn to machine learning. These approaches aim to better understand dataset behaviours based on the characteristics of IoT components and devices, and by harnessing the power of machine learning, the security of IoT devices can be significantly enhanced, reducing the potential risks associated. The dataset used in machine learning plays a crucial role in model learning. However, due to confidentiality concerns, organisations often refrain from publicly sharing their data, leading to a scarcity of IoT attack datasets and imbalanced class distributions. To address these challenges, generative adversarial models offer a promising solution by learning complex and high-dimensional distributions. Generative adversarial networks, in particular, can effectively model data structures and generate new attack vectors. In our approach, we have developed a novel architecture called CTGAN-Conv1D that combines two mean architectures: conditional tabular GAN and 1D Convolution architecture to capture various aspects of the desired output, producing realistic samples. We utilises the UNSB-15 dataset, and the results obtained using the CTGAN-Conv1D demonstrated substantial improvements. The accuracy increased from 87.49% to 94.06%, the F1 score improved from 55.04% to 93.75%, and the geometric score increased from 92.27% to 96.57%.

articleTitle: A Random Forest Algorithm for Predicting Computer Programming Skill Associated with Learning Styles
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The complexity of programming concepts such variables, loops, arrays, and functions contribute roadblocks for students learning to code. Predicting computer programming skills using machine learning is commonplace. It enables early identification of student at risk of programming failure and prompt implementation of successful early intervention strategies. Artificial intelligence relies to acquire information and rules from complicated data in order to foresee outcomes and patterns in behavior. In contrast to statistical approaches, machine learning seeks to improve prediction performance by making more accurate forecasts. Hence, we set out to investigate, using machine learning techniques, partially the Random Forest Algorithm’s (RFA) to predict vocational high school students’ proficiency in computer programming. The outcomes indicated a pass prediction of 90.23 percent, a failure prediction of 55 percent, an overall accuracy of 88.79 percent, and a total performance indicator of 91 percent across all classification cutoffs.

articleTitle: An Implementation of Android Programming Self-learning Topic for Developing Online Database Application Using Firebase
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The trend in software development recently has been toward the creation of applications for Android smartphones that impacts the growth of Android application developer demand. The Android Programming Learning Assistance System (APLAS) has been developed to study Android programming independently. Students get automatic guidance and feedback in writing source code by implementing test-driven development (TDD) method using JUnit and Robolectric. This paper presents a new implementation of Online Database topic, as the second topic in third learning stage of APLAS, for developing an Android online database application using Firebase. It provides basic functions to make e-commerce transactions consisting of user registration and login, selling, and buying goods that are interpreted into 9 activities. The topic was applied to 50 students in an Indonesian IT department to test its efficacy, and all of the students correctly completed the assignments with compliments.

articleTitle: Exploring the Boundless Potential of Deep Learning in Gender Prediction from Indonesian Names
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: The lack of ready-to-use open-source models and the absence of definite benchmarks regarding gender prediction tools using Indonesian names prompted the authors to conduct this research. In fact, this task plays a fairly important role in natural language processing (NLP), especially in terms of sentiment analysis. This study aims to explore the potential of deep learning in making predictions and to compare it with traditional machine learning models. The results show that the deep learning model performs better than these, with the highest accuracy of 97.31% on the BiLSTM architecture. The output of these models and repositories from this research will also be made available to the public for use in other products and research. This model has potential opportunities for improving government services, market research, and academic studies related to gender. In addition, it is expected to contribute to the development of the natural language processing ecosystem in Indonesia.

articleTitle: Implementation of Digital Filter Functions in Edge Device Framework for IoT Application System
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Currently, we are developing an edge device framework to help the setup of the edge device remotely through an Internet of Things (IoT) application server platform called SEMAR (Smart Environmental Monitoring and Analytical in Real-Time). The framework allows the connection of different sensor interfaces, standardizes data, and utilizes it through multiple output components. However, it lacks capabilities for sensor data processing at the edge device. In this paper, we implement filtering functions using digital signal processing techniques in the edge device framework. The techniques include low, high, and band-pass filters based on Butterworth and Chebyshev-I, as well as Kalman and Savitzky-Golay filters. By identifying these techniques and parameters in the edge configuration file through SEMAR, the user can utilize them without writing codes. It also provides the cascading filter to create a series of filters for data processing in sequences. For evaluations, we apply the proposed functions to the fingerprint-based indoor localization system (FILS15.4). The evaluation results confirmed the effectiveness of the implemented filtering functions in the edge device framework.

articleTitle: Improved Droop Control Parameters In A DC Microgrid Using The Marine Predator Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Different droop response characteristics in DC microgrid systems are impacted by inconsistent circuit parameters and line impedances.
