As a result, each converter's current division accuracy declines. DC voltage variation will result from the control response. For DC microgrids with many parallel sources, it's important to have defined controls in place to ensure system effectiveness and avoid overload. The Marine Predator Algorithm is used in this study to demonstrate droop control. This program mimics the behavior of marine predators. Particle swarm optimization is used to evaluate the performance of the suggested strategy by comparing the transient response. The load sharing case is used in this study's testing. Simulation testing is carried out using Matlab software. The MPA approach is known to have the best capability based on the simulation findings. When compared to the PSO approach, the MPA method is able to lower the voltage overshoot by 2.38%.

articleTitle: Portable Alcohol Detector using Interactive LCD Display and Android Interface
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Halal certification is a strategic step for MSMEs to retain consumers differentiate from competing MSMEs and provide added value to products. All products that enter, circulate, and are traded in Indonesia must have a halal certificate. The ethanol content in the final beverage product is tolerated at less than 0.5% as it is medically harmless. This technology has high efficiency in measuring alcohol (ethanol) content in beverage products. Designed using an 18650 battery power source and Lipo Imax B3 Pro Charger so it can be charged. Using this alcohol detector, you can measure the physical content of alcohol (ethanol) in beverages by capturing alcohol vapor. The alcohol vapor will be captured by the MQ3 sensor, which is a semiconductor sensor. In addition, the LED on the device will light up as an indication to classify the alcohol content according to the Regulation of the Minister of Health of the Republic of Indonesia No. 86/Men.Kes/Per/IV/77 on Liquor, then the Buzzer on the device will also sound as an indication of alcohol content. The sensor validation method used is to compare the actual sensor reading with the reading of the alcohol refractometer. External disturbances that can affect the reading of the device are ambient air, room temperature, and room humidity. All physical readings of alcohol content will be displayed on a TFT LCD and can be monitored directly using a smartphone on an Android application. Data can also be saved in the application on the "Historical" menu and to the database in real-time using Firebase. The characteristics of the MQ-3 sensor are able to read the alcohol content value with an accuracy of 94,67% with an error of 5,33%. The addition of Peltier and MAX 6675 thermocouple temperature sensors serves to regulate the air conditions in the sample test room so that the readings have a high level of accuracy. The application is able to display data in real time and record reading data that has been done before.

articleTitle: Identification of Air Pollution Levels Based on Sky Image Using Color Histogram Method
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Air pollution is currently a widespread issue affecting various regions around the world, including Indonesia. This research aims to assess the extent of air pollution based on sky imagery. The study’s objective is to determine air pollution levels within specific areas using sky images and to develop software capable of implementing the research findings. The research comprises three main stages. The initial stage involves image input or extraction using the cropping method. The subsequent stage encompasses preprocessing, which includes three steps: converting RGB sky images to grayscale, enhancing image quality through contrast stretching, and reducing image noise using the median filter technique. The final stage entails image processing using the color histogram method, with the air pollution levels presented in the results section. The study employs a dataset of 20 sky images, comprising 10 images depicting good air conditions and 10 images representing moderate air conditions. These images are in.jpg format, with a pixel size of 1080 x 1350. The study’s results indicate that out of the 20 input images, 18 accurately reflect the air pollution level, achieving a success rate of 90%.

articleTitle: Optimization Based Random Forest Algorithm Modification for Detecting Monkeypox Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Monkeypox is a zoonotic infectious disease caused by orthopoxvirus. Common symptoms that could indicate Monkeypox are fever, headache, muscle aches, back pain, tiredness or unwell, and swollen lymph nodes. In this research, we conducted a predictive study on Monkey Pox using the Random Forest algorithm optimized with Particle Swam Optimization, which we call PRFO. This algorithm can improve the performance of ordinary Random Forests by making a relatively fast running time and increasing the accuracy value of the algorithm. The results of tests that have been carried out on three datasets, namely: 1) The MonkeyPox dataset, which has 25 thousand data, shows an increase in the accuracy value of 2.08% from 67.80% to 69.88%, 2) The Health dataset with 20 thousand data increased by 0.89% from 92.79% to 93.67%, and 3) The PulsarStar dataset with 12 thousand data increased by 0.27%, From 97.89% to 98.16%. The increase in value is based on the PRFO parameter, which only uses 30 particles with a maximum of 50 iterations. From the tests that have been carried out, the application of the PRFO algorithm can find the best solution on a dataset with more than 10 thousand data in a relatively short time.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Random Forest and Support Vector Classifier for Student Risk Assessment: A Case Study of Colegio de Getafe
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: This research aims to compare the random forest classifier and support vector classifier to the survey data of the risk assessment system for Colegio de Getafe (CDG), a higher educational institution, to identify at-risk students and provide necessary support and interventions. The current manual data collection and analysis is time-consuming and often leads to inaccurate assessments. This study uses machine learning algorithms to analyze student survey data and classify students based on their unique characteristics, such as the differently abled, at-risk, and special needs. This study involves data collection, preprocessing, cleaning, transformation, and modeling using Random Forest and Support Vector Classifier algorithms. Evaluation metrics include accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. The results indicate that the Support Vector Classifier has an accuracy of 100%, while the Random Forest Classifier shows an accuracy of 98.09%. The SVC’s ability to capture complex relationships and decision boundaries in the data contributes to its superior performance. The findings highlight the potential of the SVC as a powerful tool for analyzing survey data in higher education and can inform decision-making and targeted interventions by school administrators. Further research can explore the implications of different data mining techniques and parameter configurations on similar datasets.

articleTitle: Electrooculogram-Based Sleepiness Detection Using Artificial Neural Network (ANN) Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Driving safety is a top priority for all road users. For motorcyclists, the safety used is a helmet, but a helmet can only provide protection without giving a warning to the user. There are various causes of traffic accidents, one of the most common causes of accidents is driver drowsiness due to fatigue. In this study, we design a helmet to prevent drowsiness for motorcycle riders using an ADS1293 to acquire an electrooculogram (EOG) signal and MAX30102 for heart rate detection. Signal changes that occur due to movements or eye blinks made by the driver and heart rate data will be processed using an artificial neural network (ANN) method to find out whether the driver is sleepy or awake. By using the forward-backpropagation algorithm on ANN to classify signals, a high accuracy of 87% was obtained. The expected warning output is in the form of a vibrator that will vibrate when the driver is drowsy, as well as a buzzer that will sound as an alarm to awaken the driver from his drowsiness. It is hoped that a warning for drowsy motorcyclists can create a sense of security for motorists and reduce the number of motorcycle accidents.

articleTitle: Batik Pattern Classification Using Decision Tree Based on Color-Texture Features
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Indonesia exhibits a wide array of conventionally crafted textiles characterized by their regional distinctiveness. East Kalimantan, a province in the Republic of Indonesia, is renowned for its traditional textile craft called Batik. The Batik produced in East Kalimantan often incorporates a diverse spectrum of hues, such as orange, green, pink, and red. The cultural themes of the Dayak people are mostly shaped by their viewpoints and philosophies of nature and the surrounding environment. Regrettably, a considerable segment of the indigenous community remains uninformed about East Kalimantan Batik, hence impeding their ability to recognize and discern its distinct characteristics. Hence, the utilization of an automated image processing technique became necessary in order to detect and categorize the predominant themes found in East Kalimantan Batik. In order to optimize classification outcomes using this strategy, it is vital to utilize appropriate and discerning features. The objective of this study is to examine the characteristics of color and texture to generate separate attributes. The color characteristics employed the occurrences of applied color inside the RGB color spaces. In order to extract textural information, the Gray Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) was utilized. The collected features were subsequently included in the Decision Tree classifier. The dataset employed in this analysis comprises 400 batik images, encompassing 100 images each of Batang Garing, Burung Enggang, Shaho, and Tameng. Through the utilization of color features, the methodology achieved a significantly high level of performance, attaining an accuracy rate of 99.9%.

articleTitle: The Influence of Load on the Oil Index for Treatment Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Power transformers are the most crucial electrical equipment in the power system. Routine testing of transformer oil insulation characteristics is necessary to estimate the level of transformer degradation. This study will implement an assessment of the database of test results for dielectric characteristics using an index-based assessment matrix method based on CIGRE TB 761 (2019). Using indices for assessment will facilitate a comprehensive evaluation of the transformer’s condition. Specifically, the database comprises 10 data points from oil characteristic tests conducted by PT. PLN UIT JBM with rated voltages of 150/20kV and 150/70kV. Additionally, the research analyzes the influence of individual oil parameters on index assessment through linear regression. Notably, strong correlations are observed between color, oil moisture, IFT, BDV, and the oil index. Furthermore, the paper examines the effect of loading on the oil index for transformers of the same operational age, revealing that higher loading factors lead to faster aging, as evidenced by oil index values of 0.8 and 0.4 with loading factors of 81.63% and 34.84%, respectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of User Satisfaction of The “PeduliLindungi” Application Using UTAUT 2 Model (Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology)
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Related to the problem of the spread of Covid-19 caused by the coronavirus that occurred in society in 2020, an application was created by the Ministry that takes care of health in the Indonesian government with the main feature as a tracker and traces the spread of the Corona Virus called PeduliLindungi. Unfortunately, with all the great features offered, this application gets complaints and dissatisfaction from its users. Therefore, the purpose of this study is to determine the user satisfaction of the PeduliLindungi application. The Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT) 2 was chosen as a reference for the research conceptual model with known constructs that can be used to measure user acceptance. The Partial Least Squares-Structural Equation Modeling (PLSSEM) method and SmartPLS 3 software were used for data analysis in this study. Of the seven constructs used in this study, four constructs successfully explain Pedulilindungi user satisfaction. The four constructs are Performance Expectations, Hedonic Motivation, Price Value, and Habit. The addition of additional variables outside of the original UTAUT 2 model or external variable model, can explain additional variability for further analysis of technology system acceptance.

articleTitle: Implementing Graph-based Grammar Subject Self-study in Adaptive English Personalized Learning System: A Design and Its Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Recently, English becomes the primary language of instruction in many universities and educational institutions around the world. Proficiency in English enables access to a wide range of educational resources, research materials, and study programs in various academic disciplines. In English study, grammar can be complex, with various tenses, verb forms, sentence structures, and rules, where students may find it challenging to grasp and apply the rules correctly, leading to errors in speaking and writing. To improve English learning effectiveness, the self-study model becomes necessary, and adaptive learning is a leading model for native students. This paper presents the implementation of English grammar self-study in Adaptive English Personalized Learning System (ADELS). By adopting domain specific graph, it is used to support self-studying English grammar by providing 10 learning topics. The assessment and evaluation are conducted through its application to ten university students. ADELS can identify areas of strength and areas that require further improvement. The prominent role of assessment in English grammar learning is taken care of by ADELS with the provision of assessment at each level and suggestions to further continue to higher level or lower level.

articleTitle: Maximum Power Observation of Small Wind Power System Based on Non-Isolated Buck-Boost Type DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: A rapid development of Small Wind Power Systems (SWPS) has occurred to meet the electricity demand in remote areas. However, there is an inherent difficulty in maximizing the power extraction in SWPS. To address this issue, the application of buck-boost type of DC-DC converters has emerged as a promising solution due to their numerous advantages. This research aims to observe the maximum power extraction of SWPS by employing two widely used buck-boost type converters: the conventional buck-boost converter and the SEPIC converter. A 10-kW SWPS is simulated using PSIM software with detailed calculations and designs for each part. The simulations were conducted under heavy and light load conditions at various wind speeds ranging between 3 and 11 m/s. The results show that both the buck-boost SWPS and SEPIC SWPS are capable of extracting the maximum power during all tests by adjusting the duty-cycle value. On average, the use of both converters can increase power extraction around 66% under heavy load and 41% under light load compared to an uncontrolled SWPS, which is only connected to a rectifier. Moreover, it was exhibited that the buck-boost SWPS has a better power extraction performance compared to the SEPIC SWPS, with only a 0.073% average difference.

articleTitle: A Cross-Sampling Method for Hidden Structure Extraction to Improve Imbalanced Multiclass Classification Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2023 Sixth International Conference on Vocational Education and Electrical Engineering (ICVEE)
abstract: Class prediction problems in classification cases are often faced with irregular data conditions. This research contributes to providing a more structured hidden pattern extraction approach to data sets that already have class labels. The process of taking samples from data collection in this study is called the cross-sampling (CS) technique. The basic idea of this technique is to regroup the data using the appropriate clustering method. This study applied the Mini Batch K-Mean and Spectral algorithms to four public datasets with an imbalanced multiclass distribution. The grouping results are then assigned a label based on the original label reference using the pattern-matching concept on the first principal component through the PCA procedure. The labelling results are then used as external validation for the actual data labels to represent all classes. The validation results produce a confusion matrix used as the basis for the cross-sampling method. The dataset before cross-sampling and the results of cross-sampling were compared to the performance of the classification prediction accuracy using the F1-Score and Area Under Curve (AUC) measurements. The statistical hypothesis testing results show a significant difference in performance before and after the cross-sampling procedure. This difference is demonstrated by the accuracy of all the classification algorithms used, which increased significantly from the average performance value of 82.09% to 96.7%.
